rows.en:
These are also our Naager's flagship products… Please try Kelbaan and Gigant.

We are confident they will prove useful to you without fail.
If you insist, I'll use them! But… they had better be weapons that actually work.
We shall await good news. Until then, farewell…
Hmph…
Happy birthday, Rumi.
You're 13 from today, aren't you?
Study hard, okay! Just kidding…
Dad, sis, Saburo… thank you.
Well now… How many years has it been since we celebrated Rumi's birthday like this?
Oh, forget celebrating… it's been months since the whole family even sat down to eat together, Dad.

Hello, Sahara speaking… What!?

A flying battleship? The Brain Party robot that attacked the jumbo jet over Oshima?

The First Combat Air Base? Understood, I'll be right there!
Dad…

The air base has been hit. I thought they'd been lying low for a while…

Chie, Saburo, carry on with Rumi's party. Mr. Tachibana's friends should be arriving any time now.

Dad…

Sis and Saburo should go with you too!
I'm sorry, Rumi. On your birthday, too…

No, it's okay… I'm used to being alone by now. I'm not lonely.

More importantly… everyone, please be careful.
Let's see… It must be around here, right? Dr. Sahara's house…
I'm sorry. I wasn't any help…
Hm? Oh… You mean Rumi's birthday present? You're still worried about that?

Yes…

Even when I'm told to pick something a girl would like, I have no idea at all…
My bad… I'm sorry, I didn't think. You'd have no reason to be interested in something like a gift, and no way to understand its value. It's not something you need…

Yes…

But I understood that in Japan there is a custom called a birthday, where one gives a gift called a present…
Hmm, well, actually… I think birthdays are the same all over the universe, you know?
By the way, [HERO2]… What exactly is a birthday?

Ah…!?

No, I see… You don't even have a birthday…

Don't worry about it. I don't have a birthday either! If I have one at all…

it's that time… the day you saved me when I was wounded in my battle with Gavan…
The day you awakened to your own self, [HERO2]…? Is that it?

That's right…

The me who was reborn, and you who stand by me… That day is our birthday.
That day is our birthday…

Someday, the two of us…

…!?

Gigant!?

Transferring armor-up coordinates to the command satellite! Setting: "Combat Under Gravity". Weapon select: "Close Combat". Roaring Steel, ready to activate!!

…Er…

How can you switch modes so suddenly?
Huh? Did I make some mistake?
It's the opposite! You're too perfect, [HERO4]… All right, let's go!

[HERO2]…

Is being perfect a bad thing?

[HERO2]…

Is being perfect a bad thing?
You… still on about that? Focus on the battle for now!
You… still on about that? Focus on the battle for now!
That's strange? Where's it trying to go? Does it have some objective?
That's strange? Where's it trying to go? Does it have some objective?

…!?

Where is it trying to go, I wonder? Does it have some objective…?

…!?

Where is it trying to go, I wonder? Does it have some objective…?
Hey… When are we going to get there?
That's weird? Is this map really right?
Says you… The truth is you just have no sense of direction.
You're one to talk! You couldn't even find your way back to your own parents' house…
But… I was flustered that time! And [HERO2], you were going "uuugh" and stuff…
Anyway, we're seriously late! Isn't it already over? Rumi's birthday…

If it is… it's your fault, [HERO2]! Even the cake, look…

Ah… It really did melt…
See, didn't I tell you? Get a normal cake, I said…
But… I wanted to eat an ice cream one!
A birthday cake should just be a strawberry one.
Besides, Dr. Sahara said he's got one ready. All those cakes…
But… but I want to eat it! [HERO2], you meanie!
[HERO4]! This is no time to be saying that!

What! I don't care anymore!

…Is what I'd like to say, but I can't, can I? Not when it's Gigant…

[HERO4]! Just throw it away already…

that cake!

[HERO4]! Just throw it away already…

that cake!
No way… It's still edible!
No way… It's still edible!
That's weird? Is it trying to go somewhere? What's its objective?
That's weird? Is it trying to go somewhere? What's its objective?
That's weird? Looks like it's trying to go somewhere…? Does it have some objective?
That's weird? Looks like it's trying to go somewhere…? Does it have some objective?
Kyaaaah… Help me!! Dad, sis!
Damn!? So their target was Rumi?
Damn!? So their target was Rumi?

…!?

Their target was Rumi?

…!?

Their target was Rumi?
Damn!? Their target was Rumi all along!
Damn!? Their target was Rumi all along!
No way…!? Their target was Rumi?
No way…!? Their target was Rumi?

Thanks to One-Seven, we managed to drive off the Battleship Robot…

But to think there was a pilot in the Brain robot.
That's a first, isn't it, Doctor…
Why would Brain use a human pilot in a robot?
If a robot has a human pilot, One-Seven can't use its Graviton attack. That's why Brain…
No, but… that alone isn't enough to defeat One-Seven! There may be some other scheme…
Fatheeer!!
What's wrong, Chie? What happened?
Rumi! Rumi is…

uncertain: U07385/U07391: お姉さん rendered "sis"; 三郎君 rendered "Saburo".
U07398: [HERO2] (route where [HERO4] is a non-human partner) — his apology read as being about her lacking human interests; phrasing kept close to source.
U07402: [HERO2]'s backstory (wounded in a battle with Gavan, saved by [HERO4]) is route-specific; translated literally.
U07407: 装着 rendered "armor-up"; 貢力下戦闘 read as 重力下戦闘 ("Combat Under Gravity"); 轟機鋼 rendered "Roaring Steel" per glossary title.
U07415-U07418, U07437-U07440: "it" refers to the Gigant/robot that is moving off; inferred from U07442.
U07429: そんなケーキばかりでも… unfinished; rendered "All those cakes…"; Dr. Sahara referred to as "he".
U07412/U07414 etc.: Fadita/Lucifard/Vortex/Velvet repeat the [HERO4]/[HERO2] lines; translated identically.
